title: Young Affectionate Couple Outdoors, 1940s B&W Vintage Snapshot Photo
description: An intimate mid-1940s black-and-white snapshot of a young couple posing outdoors. The man stands affectionately behind the woman with his hands resting on her shoulders. She wears a dark garment accented by a prominent white Peter Pan collar and sports a wartime-era rolled hairstyle. An evergreen shrub frames the background under bright, high-contrast sunlight.
